protocol.checkpoint_policy: Select latest complete hero checkpoint once at pair setup in-region; temporarily retain until both arms are terminal; require identical restored URI and step; restore original retention metadata.
protocol.rack_policy: A pair holds one 16-host, 64-GB200 allocation through both arms. Require identical task/attempt, hostname, local GPU UUIDs, local device assignment and NVLink rack for both arms; no retries or migration.
protocol.purpose: Four pairs comparing accepted training with combined routed-expert mask removal and tail-only output clearing. Each pair runs both arms in fresh processes within one physical 64-GB200 allocation.

statistics.estimand: mean(control run-mean duration) / mean(candidate run-mean duration) - 1
statistics.primary: Score all relative updates 8 through 63 inclusive with equal run weighting. Pair is the replicate. Report paired Fieller 95% throughput interval using t critical value for 3 degrees of freedom and paired-t seconds saved.
statistics.sensitivity: Exclude absolute step numbers divisible by 10; retain all other primary samples.
statistics.decision: Require a positive lower primary throughput interval and acceptable provenance, loss and memory evidence before promotion. No timing-based early acceptance or extra pairs.
statistics.invalid_runs: Retain failed or provenance-mismatched runs and investigate before further submission; never replace based on duration. Any protocol amendment precedes further measurements.

protocol.loss_policy: Record all 64 finite losses per arm at matched restored steps. Report every candidate-minus-control difference in nats, initial difference, signed mean, maximum absolute difference, last-seven mean and comparison with earlier same-source repeat variation. Investigate same-sign differences across all 56 scored updates, nonfinite values, or unexplained sustained drift before promotion. Exact component outputs and gradients matched; short training trajectories do not establish long-term convergence. Do not discard timing samples for unfavorable losses.
protocol.baseline_policy: Both arms retain segmented forward attention, accepted native SM100 backward, default NCCL policy and ragged-all-to-all-only symmetric registration. Native-forward, shared-MLP and copy-engine candidates remain excluded.
protocol.kernel_validation: Both arms require 192 segmented forward and 96 native SM100 backward launches in the rank-0 two-update profile, with no native forward launches. Control must have zero _zero_grouped_output_tail launches; candidate must have at least one. Record the actual tail count for per-layer attribution. Verify all production source hashes on every rank.
protocol.memory_policy: Collect rank-0 allocator counters and compiler buffer assignments from regional profiles for both arms. Require no OOM, investigate unexpected peak or rematerialization changes, and report process-lifetime versus compiler-plan limits explicitly.
protocol.timeout_scope: Aggregate 55-minute GPU-process deadline covers both arms, source preparation and validation; queue time is excluded. No simultaneous experiment job trees.

pairs.memory_scope: Global rank 0 local GPU JAX allocator counters. Peak is process-lifetime high-water mark; it includes initialization and compilation. It is not total device memory across CUDA, NCCL and other allocators.
